# Project Overview

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Purpose

J.A.R.V.I.S. answers an operator's text/voice messages through AI models and agents, runs tools and MCP connectors behind owner approval, and keeps per-user long-term vector memory, exposed as a Vue 3 SPA/PWA over a Laravel 13 `api/v1` with a Filament admin at `/admin` (`README.md`, `routes/api.php`, `app/Providers/Filament/AdminPanelProvider.php`).

### Business problem

- Multi-user assistant with no self-registration: accounts come only from the admin (`routes/api.php` header comment; `app/Filament/Resources/Users`).
- AI calls bill per token: monthly per-user cost cap blocks new calls (`app/Services/CostLimitGuard.php`, HTTP `402` in `ConversationMessageController`).
- Provider outages: replies fall through an ordered model chain (`app/Services/FallbackChain.php`, `BrainClient::stream`).
- Write/sensitive tool actions need explicit owner approval before running (`app/Tools/ToolExecutor.php`, `app/Services/ApprovalService.php`).
- Tool/connector output is untrusted: delimited and neutralized before reaching a model (`app/Support/UntrustedContent.php`).
- Memory must not store sensitive data (CPF, cards, passwords, API keys, health terms) unless explicit (`app/Services/SensitiveDataDetector.php`).

### Consumers and integrations

| System | Role |
|---|---|
| Vue 3 SPA/PWA (`resources/js/app.ts`, `public/sw.js`) | Operator UI (HUD, chat, memories, approvals, activity, settings); calls `/api/v1` with Sanctum cookie |
| Filament admin `/admin` (`app/Filament/`) | Admin CRUD: users, AI providers/models, agents, tools, MCP servers, settings, usage, audit logs |
| Laravel Reverb (`compose.yaml` service `reverb`) | WebSocket push on `private-user.{id}` (`routes/channels.php`) |
| AI providers via `laravel/ai` (`config/ai.php`, `app/Services/ProviderRegistry.php`) | Text streaming, structured output, embeddings |
| Remote MCP servers via `laravel/mcp` (`app/Services/McpClient.php`) | Connector tool discovery and calls (HTTP only, no stdio) |
| REST/webhook endpoints (`app/Tools/HttpToolHandler.php`) | Catalogue tools of type `rest` / `webhook` |
| PostgreSQL + pgvector (`compose.yaml` `pgsql`) | Primary store + memory embeddings |
| Redis (`compose.yaml` `redis`) | Queue, cache, session, cancellation flags |
| Health probe `GET /up` (`HealthController`) | DB, Redis, Reverb check outside `web` group (`bootstrap/app.php`) |

### Macro flow

1. SPA posts `POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/messages` (`content` ≤8000, `source` `text|voice`).
2. `ConversationMessageController::store` checks cost limit (402), persists the user message, broadcasts `conversation.message.created`, dispatches `ProcessUserMessage` on Redis; returns `202`.
3. `ProcessUserMessage` creates a `pending` assistant message, broadcasts `assistant.state.changed` (`THINKING`) + `assistant.thinking`.
4. `IntentRouter::route` classifies intent (`direct_answer|use_tool|delegate_agent|long_task`) or honours an `@slug` prefix; stores `messages.meta.routing`.
5. Direct answer → `BrainClient::stream` through `FallbackChain`; agent intents → `AgentRunner::run` (tools, delegation, tool-call limit, timeout).
6. Each chunk broadcasts `assistant.response.chunk`; usage rows written per attempt (`UsageRecorder`).
7. `StructuredResultExtractor` optionally produces a typed result (`table`, `list`, …) validated against `resources/schemas/results/*.json`.
8. Assistant message saved `completed` with `payload`/`result_type_id`; broadcasts `assistant.response.completed` + state `IDLE`.
9. Follow-ups: `ExtractMemoryHypotheses` on queue `low`; `GenerateConversationTitle` when title is provisional.

### Out of scope

- MCP `stdio` transport: rejected by `McpUrlValidator` ("stdio não é suportado").
- Self-registration: no register route in `routes/api.php`.
- Exposing this app as an MCP server: `routes/ai.php` holds only a commented-out example.
